name: lightweaver
description: Surgebinders who command Illumination and Transformation. Lightweavers are artists, liars, and truth-speakers — weaving illusions from light and self-understanding from lies. Their strength lies not in vows, but in personal truths.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: first truth
ideals.description: The Lightweaver's path is unique — they progress by speaking deep personal truths, not shared oaths. Each 'ideal' is a confession of self.
quotes: I lied to them because I couldn’t admit I was broken.

ideals.label: second truth
ideals.description: Another layer peeled away. The Lightweaver exposes a deeper truth about who they are, or what they’ve done.
quotes: I am not who I pretend to be.

ideals.label: third truth
ideals.description: With each truth, the illusion breaks — and so do the chains that bind the Lightweaver to a false self.
quotes: I hate the person they think I am.
I want to be loved, but I don’t think I deserve it.

ideals.label: fourth truth
ideals.description: An admission not just of darkness, but of hope — a truth that sets a new path in motion.
quotes: I want to be someone better.
